local_decoded_mask_audit.scope_limit: Repository-local raster comparison only; it does not establish global novelty, geologic validity, or holdout performance.

h33_raster.attribution_to_extradr19_score: Not established; the leaderboard snapshot has no filename/hash or upload-receipt mapping.

material_discrepancies: The incoming H83 README said SUBMIT YES although the H83 run card records HOLDOUT-DTI NOT_EVALUATED and leaves approval unset.
The incoming H83 index and executive guides gave portal-submission steps despite the missing holdout and absent organizer receipt.
The linked h83-candidate.tif is the 81076-byte all-finite raster, while h83-candidate.json records the separate 1558064-byte NaN/nodata variant.
The run-card note says there are no prior submissions in the repository, but 124 other tracked TIFFs share the candidate grid; a local decoded-mask comparison was therefore run.

A local comparison used the hash-pinned sample_submission.tif mirror from GEMSDOE24: the linked H83 file matches its grid and all 37,654 positives fall within the mirror finite-cell support, while the distinct variant has 161 positives outside and 3,073 mirror-finite cells encoded as NaN. The mirror is not organizer-authenticated, so exact organizer-mask semantics and portal compatibility remain unverified.

The dated public leaderboard snapshot does record DARD at 0.3195 (rank 7) and extradr19 at 0.2778 (rank 17), with the leader at 0.3774; it is team-level only and does not bind either score to a specific TIFF. In particular, the H33 raster hash is not linked to the extradr19 score by an organizer receipt.

disposition.reason: No comparable spatial-block holdout or H83 organizer score receipt. The local template check uses an integrity-pinned owner-supplied mirror, not organizer-authenticated bytes; no basis for submission approval.
